_note: Owner-approved compartment answers for the sofa lines still on a bare -1S placeholder on PROCEEDED company-1 orders, 2026-09-04. Same shape as sofa-compartment-corrections-2026-08.json. Every entry names the documents it applies to, the model, the target piece list, the seat where the book or the slip states one, the desc2Match that tells one build on a document from another, and a why recording how the answer was reached. Four entries are the owner's own reading, given in chat; the rest are read off the photograph and confirmed by him.
_rules: Money never moves: the price rides the FIRST piece and every other piece is 0. Lines are matched to target pieces and UPDATED in place so a row id - and any purchase allocation hanging off it - survives. A document can hold MORE THAN ONE sofa build, so desc2Match is required; where a document holds TWO lines with the SAME text those are two identical sofas and both take the build.

owner 2026-09-05, in his own words: "1ELT 就是L来的" (1ELT IS the chaise, L) and "1Abox 是1NALT" (1ABOX is what the slip writes as 1NALT). That RETIRES the earlier reading. This entry used to say 1ABOX(LHF)+1NA+2A(RHF), copied from HC-PO-000254 because the purchase order was the only evidence available - but the purchase order got that from the 2026-08 round, which reached it from the SPELLING alone (its why: "the ELT/T spelling has no parser rule"), and fix-modenza-label-and-5526-pieces.mjs minted 5526-1ABOX(LHF) so that guess could be written. A guess copied onto a second document is still one guess. The owner's ruling settles it, and the purchase order is corrected in the same PR so the two sides still agree. scripts/lib/parse-sofa.mjs independently agrees: on "1 ELT + NA + 2ER" it emits L(LHF)+1NA+2A(RHF), and 1ABOX(LHF) is what it emits for 1NALT (pinned in scripts/lib/parse-sofa.test.mjs). On the REAL text it emits nothing - the stray "/ T" splits the segment, conf=low - which is why this build is corrected from this file rather than by re-running the decoder. This line has no photograph at all: 0 rows in both photo manifests and the full-book export reported 0 failed lines, so the book never carried one. 5526-L(LHF) is opened by scripts/open-5526-chaise.mjs; this correction REFUSES until it exists.
